purpose: BTX-weighted customer universe for POC. Replaces the prior 78-account public-market universe with ~30 accounts anchored to what BTX Precision actually serves. Lockheed Martin is marked BTX_CONFIRMED per Kapil relay of Jamie Goettler CRO attestation (largest BTX customer). Anchor set of standard top-tier accounts marked BTX_CONFIRMED with GUESSED_STANDARD_TOP_TIER_POC_ONLY confidence tag so sellers see them as current customers while provenance carries the honesty flag. Public-source-evidenced accounts (Boeing via Chandler, Zimmer/Biomet via Maitland, AFIT via i3D) retain PUBLICLY_EVIDENCED_RELATIONSHIP state.

truth_rules.public_identity: Every account has verified public identity via official domain and reputable public source.
truth_rules.btx_internal_relationship: BTX_CONFIRMED status requires either (a) a BTX BU public statement, (b) a Jamie/CRO attestation, or (c) a POC-guessed standard-top-tier tag when the account is a natural fit for BTX capabilities and the user has directed guessed classification.
truth_rules.external_priority: Prospect priority is a research judgment; it never asserts BTX purchase history.
truth_rules.override: Any BTX_CONFIRMED with confidence tag GUESSED_STANDARD_TOP_TIER_POC_ONLY is overridable by BTX internal Prism/Paperless/HubSpot evidence when connected.

relationship_states.BTX_CONFIRMED: Either publicly attested by a BTX BU, internally attested by BTX CRO/leadership, or POC-guessed top-tier fit per user directive.
relationship_states.PUBLICLY_EVIDENCED_RELATIONSHIP: A non-BTX public source connects the account to BTX manufacturing context.
relationship_states.PUBLIC_INTERACTION_INFERENCE: Inferred fit based on capability + geography + industry corridor overlap; not evidence.
relationship_states.NO_RELATIONSHIP_EVIDENCE: Prospect or watch account without BTX-supplier signal.

relationship_confidence_values.HIGH: Strong public source or firm internal attestation.
relationship_confidence_values.HIGH_INTERNAL_ATTESTATION: Named by BTX CRO or equivalent leadership.
relationship_confidence_values.GUESSED_STANDARD_TOP_TIER_POC_ONLY: POC assumption that this standard top-tier account is a current customer; must be verified against BTX internal systems.

codex_guardrails: Preserve every account's provenance field on ingestion; do not strip source_ids or basis.
Do not auto-promote PUBLICLY_EVIDENCED_RELATIONSHIP to BTX_CONFIRMED at runtime without new evidence.
Do not auto-demote BTX_CONFIRMED with GUESSED_STANDARD_TOP_TIER_POC_ONLY confidence; instead surface the tag to sellers so they know to validate.
When BTX internal Prism/Paperless/HubSpot data becomes available, use it to reclassify accounts and stamp new provenance.
Do not fabricate contacts, quotes, or orders for these accounts; use only the accompanying contacts, quotes, orders files with declared provenance.
PUBLIC_INTERACTION_INFERENCE and NO_RELATIONSHIP_EVIDENCE accounts render as prospects, not current customers.
AFIT is an academic-DoD collaboration recorded on i3D's public case study; do not treat as a commercial customer.
